verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question for a SaaS agent platform like Sierra, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of API versioning or a deprecation policy. The cited material covers adjacent topics: change tracking for agent code, release governance (merge approvals, split traffic), and probes showing no public OpenAPI spec. None of that is a versioned public API with a documented deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
